syllabus_topics: Introduction. Culture, ethics and organizational structure.
assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) in the Normal Period is the sum of two mini-tests (4.5 points each), the IST Management Challenge (2 points), and an exam (9 points). There are no minimum grades for the mini-tests or the exam in the Normal Period. In the Recourse Period, a 1.5-hour exam covering all material accounts for 100% of the final grade. The better grade between the Normal and Recourse periods will be counted. For Special Period and Working Students, a single 1.5-hour exam accounts for 100% of the final grade.
